arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,(select group_concat(c.charge_id||":"||c.idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b
select * from charges where booking_id in (select booking_id from bookings where status="pending")
select b.booking_id,b.status,c.state from bookings b left join charges c using(booking_id) where b.status="pending"
select event_id,booking_id,substr(payload,1,60) p,status,attempts from outbox where status!="delivered" and (attempts>0 or payload not like "{\"schema_version\": 1, \"booking_id\": \"bkg_%")

select o.event_id,o.booking_id,o.payload,o.attempts,b.flight_id,b.status from outbox o left join bookings b using(booking_id) where o.status="pending" and (o.attempts>0 or o.payload not like "%bkg_%" or o.event_id<"evt_00000011")

select o.event_id,substr(o.payload,1,200) p,o.attempts,o.status from outbox o where o.status!="delivered" and o.status!="quarantined" and (o.attempts>0 or o.event_id<"evt_00000014") order by 1 limit 12
select status,message,count(*) n from (select * from request_logs order by id desc limit 25) group by 1,2

select (select count(*) from bookings where status="confirmed") conf,(select count(*) from checkins) ck,(select count(*) from outbox where status="pending") pend,(select count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from checkins c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) nock
